sentences.en: There is very little probability of an agreement being reached.
sentences.zh: 达成协议的可能性非常小。

sentences.en: We'll have our firm's attorneys look through the provisional agreement.
sentences.zh: 我们会让公司的律师审查一下这份初步协议。

sentences.en: You can't identify silence with agreement when you visit Japan.
sentences.zh: 在日本的时候可别把沉默当成同意哦。
